# @loom/storage

One storage package for every platform, with a subpath per runtime so a bundler only sees the code
it needs.

- `@loom/storage` — runtime-neutral key/value store for the web and mobile apps.
- `@loom/storage/ui` — IndexedDB and Web Storage adapters plus the default browser resolver.
- `@loom/storage/capacitor` — encrypted SQLite through `@capacitor-community/sqlite`.
- `@loom/storage/server` — object store for Bun and Cloudflare Workers.

Client: `createKeyValueStore(adapter)` stores namespaced JSON records with an `updatedAt`; the
generic `get<T>`/`put<T>`/`list<T>` methods keep the payload typed. `getDefaultKeyValueStore()` picks
native SQLite when the mobile app injects `createCapacitorSqliteAdapter`, then IndexedDB, then Web
Storage, then memory.

Server: `createObjectStorage({ config, bindings })` resolves a driver by name — `local` (Bun
filesystem), `s3` (`Bun.S3Client`), `r2` (Worker binding), or `memory`. `put`/`get`/`delete`/
`exists`/`url` plus `putJson`/`getJson` cover the surface; keys reject traversal. The driver name is
validated immediately and the transport is built on first use, so a runtime-specific driver never
crashes startup.
